record.question: Which of the following diseases is caused by Protozoa?
record.explanation: Answer C: Malaria. Malaria is caused by Plasmodium protozoan parasites; common cold is viral, cholera bacterial, and pneumonia has multiple possible causes. Reference: https://www.who.int/news-room/fact-sheets/detail/malaria. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
